React:

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import {
  Archive02Icon,
  Copy01Icon,
  CopyLinkIcon,
  Delete02Icon,
  MoreHorizontalIcon,
  PencilEdit02Icon,
} from "@hugeicons/core-free-icons";
import {
  ActionBar,
  ActionBarActions,
  ActionBarButton,
  ActionBarClose,
  ActionBarCount,
  ActionBarSelection,
  ActionBarSeparator,
  Badge,
  Button,
  Checkbox,
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuLabel,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
  Icon,
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCaption,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
  TableRowActions,
  toast,
} from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";

const records = [
  { id: "PRJ-101", name: "Brand Kit 2026", owner: "Maya Lin", status: "Active", variant: "success", updated: "2h ago" },
  { id: "PRJ-102", name: "Mobile Onboarding Screenshots", owner: "Ari Cohen", status: "Review", variant: "warning", updated: "5h ago" },
  { id: "PRJ-103", name: "Q4 Social Campaign", owner: "Noa Levi", status: "Draft", variant: "muted", updated: "Yesterday" },
  { id: "PRJ-104", name: "Customer Directory Sync", owner: "Danilo Silva", status: "Active", variant: "success", updated: "Sep 14" },
] as const;

export default function Example() {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string[]>(["PRJ-101"]);
  const all = selected.length === records.length;
  const toggle = (id: string, on: boolean) =>
    setSelected((list) => (on ? [...list, id] : list.filter((x) => x !== id)));

  return (
    <div className="ayy-stack" style={{ inlineSize: "100%" }}>
      <Table>
        <TableCaption className="ayy-sr-only">Projects with inline actions, secondary menus and bulk selection</TableCaption>
        <TableHeader>
          <TableRow>
            <TableHead select>
              <Checkbox
                aria-label="Select all projects"
                checked={all}
                indeterminate={selected.length > 0 && !all}
                onCheckedChange={(on) => setSelected(on ? records.map((r) => r.id) : [])}
              />
            </TableHead>
            <TableHead>Project</TableHead>
            <TableHead>Owner</TableHead>
            <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
            <TableHead>Updated</TableHead>
            <TableHead actions>
              <span className="ayy-sr-only">Actions</span>
            </TableHead>
          </TableRow>
        </TableHeader>
        <TableBody>
          {records.map((item) => (
            <TableRow key={item.id} selected={selected.includes(item.id)}>
              <TableCell select>
                <Checkbox
                  aria-label={`Select ${item.name}`}
                  checked={selected.includes(item.id)}
                  onCheckedChange={(on) => toggle(item.id, on)}
                />
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell>{item.name}</TableCell>
              <TableCell className="ayy-muted">{item.owner}</TableCell>
              <TableCell>
                <Badge variant={item.variant}>{item.status}</Badge>
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell className="ayy-muted">{item.updated}</TableCell>
              <TableCell actions>
                <TableRowActions>
                  <Button
                    variant="ghost"
                    size="icon-sm"
                    aria-label={`Edit ${item.name}`}
                    onClick={() => toast(`Edit ${item.name}`)}
                  >
                    <Icon icon={PencilEdit02Icon} />
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    variant="ghost"
                    size="icon-sm"
                    aria-label={`Copy link to ${item.name}`}
                    onClick={() => toast.success(`Copied link to ${item.name}`)}
                  >
                    <Icon icon={CopyLinkIcon} />
                  </Button>
                  <DropdownMenu>
                    <DropdownMenuTrigger
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="icon-sm"
                      aria-label={`More actions for ${item.name}`}
                    >
                      <Icon icon={MoreHorizontalIcon} />
                    </DropdownMenuTrigger>
                    <DropdownMenuContent align="end">
                      <DropdownMenuLabel>{item.name}</DropdownMenuLabel>
                      <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => toast(`Edit ${item.name}`)}>
                        <Icon icon={PencilEdit02Icon} />
                        Edit
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                      <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => toast.success(`Duplicated ${item.name}`)} shortcut="Mod+D">
                        <Icon icon={Copy01Icon} />
                        Duplicate
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                      <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => toast.success(`Copied ${item.name}`)} shortcut="Mod+C">
                        <Icon icon={CopyLinkIcon} />
                        Copy link
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                      <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => toast(`Archived ${item.name}`)}>
                        <Icon icon={Archive02Icon} />
                        Archive
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                      <DropdownMenuSeparator />
                      <DropdownMenuItem destructive onSelect={() => toast.error(`Deleted ${item.name}`)}>
                        <Icon icon={Delete02Icon} />
                        Delete
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                    </DropdownMenuContent>
                  </DropdownMenu>
                </TableRowActions>
              </TableCell>
            </TableRow>
          ))}
        </TableBody>
      </Table>

      <ActionBar open={selected.length > 0} onClear={() => setSelected([])}>
        <ActionBarSelection>
          <ActionBarCount>{selected.length} selected</ActionBarCount>
          <ActionBarClose />
        </ActionBarSelection>
        <ActionBarSeparator />
        <ActionBarActions>
          <ActionBarButton onClick={() => toast(`Editing ${selected.length} selected`)}>
            <Icon icon={PencilEdit02Icon} />
            Edit
          </ActionBarButton>
          <ActionBarButton onClick={() => toast.success(`Duplicated ${selected.length} selected`)}>
            <Icon icon={Copy01Icon} />
            Duplicate
          </ActionBarButton>
          <ActionBarButton onClick={() => toast.success(`Copied ${selected.length} links`)}>
            <Icon icon={CopyLinkIcon} />
            Copy
          </ActionBarButton>
          <ActionBarButton onClick={() => toast(`Archived ${selected.length} selected`)}>
            <Icon icon={Archive02Icon} />
            Archive
          </ActionBarButton>
          <ActionBarSeparator />
          <ActionBarButton
            destructive
            onClick={() => {
              toast.error(`Deleted ${selected.length} selected`);
              setSelected([]);
            }}
          >
            <Icon icon={Delete02Icon} />
            Delete
          </ActionBarButton>
        </ActionBarActions>
      </ActionBar>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Grid

Category: Data display. Multi-select card grid for media assets, project cards, social media posts, screenshots and user records. Pairs card selection checkboxes, inline and ⋯ secondary item actions, a select-all toolbar and the floating bottom Action bar. Also called: data-grid, card-grid, media-grid, asset-grid, gallery-grid, tile-grid.

**Classes**
- `.ayy-grid-wrap` — Stack wrapper grouping the grid toolbar, the card grid and the floating Action bar.
- `.ayy-grid__toolbar` — Header bar above the grid holding the select-all checkbox, count and sorting or view controls.
- `.ayy-grid__select-all` — Labelled select-all checkbox control in the grid toolbar.
- `.ayy-grid` — Responsive CSS grid container: as many card columns of at least --ayy-min (16rem) as fit.
- `.ayy-grid--compact` — Dense variant (--ayy-min: 13rem, tighter gap and card padding) for media libraries and directories.
- `.ayy-grid__item` — Selectable record card (<article>). Highlights with a 2px text-colour border and tint when aria-selected="true".
- `.ayy-grid__media` — Top preview frame for images, screenshots, social post visuals or video thumbnails. Floating glass corners when .ayy-grid__select or .ayy-grid__actions sit inside.
- `.ayy-grid__header` — Top block of the card holding the checkbox, avatar/icon, title, description and item actions.
- `.ayy-grid__select` — Wrapper for the card's selection Checkbox (inline in the header or floating in the top-start corner of .ayy-grid__media).
- `.ayy-grid__actions` — Cluster of quick action buttons (Edit, Copy) and the ⋯ DropdownMenu trigger (inline in the header or floating in the top-end corner of .ayy-grid__media).
- `.ayy-grid__actions--reveal` — Reveals item actions when the card is hovered, focused within, selected or has an open menu (stays visible on touch screens).
- `.ayy-grid__title` — Card heading (<h3>).
- `.ayy-grid__description` — Muted subtitle, handle or supporting metadata line.
- `.ayy-grid__body` — Card body content between header and footer.
- `.ayy-grid__footer` — Bottom bar for status Badges, timestamps or avatars, pinned to the bottom of stretched cards.

**States**
- `default` — Responsive grid of surface cards with line borders, rest shadow, optional top media preview, header, body and hairline footer.
- `hover` (`.ayy-grid__item:hover`) — Card border turns line-hover and reveals .ayy-grid__actions--reveal.
- `pressed` — doesn't apply: No pressed look; clicking a selectable card or its checkbox toggles selection on release.
- `focus` (`.ayy-grid__item:focus-within`) — Reveals .ayy-grid__actions--reveal while any checkbox, button or menu trigger inside the card has keyboard focus.
- `disabled` — doesn't apply: Cards aren't disabled; disable the controls inside them.
- `selected` (`.ayy-grid__item[aria-selected="true"] (with a Checkbox in .ayy-grid__select)`) — Text-colour border plus a 1px ring and a 4% text tint over the surface. Forced colours: Highlight outline.
- `error` — doesn't apply: Show a failed load as an Alert with a retry instead of the grid.
- `loading` — doesn't apply: No loading look; render Skeleton cards in the grid layout with aria-busy on the container.

**Sizes**
- Density — Card padding is fixed (16px, 12px when compact); checkboxes and action buttons inside follow data-density.
- Width — Fills its container with auto-fitting columns at least --ayy-min wide (16rem default, 13rem compact).

**Custom element** `<ayy-grid>` (@danitesler/ayywi/elements) — 
- event `ayy-selection-change`: { items } — the selected .ayy-grid__item elements.

**React** — `import { GridWrap, GridToolbar, GridSelectAll, Grid, GridItem, GridItemMedia, GridItemHeader, GridItemSelect, GridItemActions, GridItemTitle, GridItemDescription, GridItemBody, GridItemFooter } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";`
- `<GridWrap>` renders <div class="ayy-grid-wrap">. Props: 
- `<GridToolbar>` renders <div class="ayy-grid__toolbar">. Props: 
- `<GridSelectAll>` renders <label class="ayy-grid__select-all">. Props: 
- `<Grid>` renders <div class="ayy-grid">. Props: `compact` boolean — denser cards and 13rem minimum column width; `min` string — minimum column width (--ayy-min, default "16rem")
- `<GridItem>` renders <article class="ayy-grid__item">. Props: `selected` boolean — sets aria-selected; `onSelectedChange` (selected: boolean) => void — toggles selection when the card body is clicked
- `<GridItemMedia>` renders <div class="ayy-grid__media">. Props: 
- `<GridItemHeader>` renders <div class="ayy-grid__header">. Props: 
- `<GridItemSelect>` renders <div class="ayy-grid__select">. Props: 
- `<GridItemActions>` renders <div class="ayy-grid__actions">. Props: `reveal` boolean — reveal on card hover, focus-within or selection (stays visible on touch)
- `<GridItemTitle>` renders <h3 class="ayy-grid__title">. Props: 
- `<GridItemDescription>` renders <p class="ayy-grid__description">. Props: 
- `<GridItemBody>` renders <div class="ayy-grid__body">. Props: 
- `<GridItemFooter>` renders <div class="ayy-grid__footer">. Props: 

**Accessibility**
- Each selectable card contains a native Checkbox in GridItemSelect with an aria-label naming the item ("Select Hero screenshot").
- Selected cards carry aria-selected="true" and a 2px border (Highlight outline in High Contrast mode), never colour alone.
- Per-card icon buttons and ⋯ DropdownMenu triggers carry an aria-label naming the item ("More actions for Hero screenshot").
- GridItemActions with reveal uses opacity so controls remain in the Tab order and become visible on :focus-within.

**Do**
- Use Grid when items are browsed visually or as cards — media assets, screenshots, social media posts, projects and user records — and need multi-select and per-item actions like a Table.
- Put GridItemSelect and GridItemActions inside GridItemMedia for visual cards (screenshots, media, social posts), or inside GridItemHeader for record cards (projects, users).
- Provide a ⋯ DropdownMenu on each card for targeted secondary actions (Edit, Duplicate, Copy, Archive, Delete) and an ActionBar at the bottom for bulk actions on selected cards.

**Don't**
- Don't use Grid for static marketing feature tiles that aren't selectable records — use plain Cards in an .ayy-grid layout.
- Don't use Grid for single-choice form inputs (like picking a pricing plan) — use ChoiceCard.
- Don't hide the selection checkbox on selected cards.

React:

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import {
  Archive02Icon,
  Copy01Icon,
  CopyLinkIcon,
  Delete02Icon,
  Image01Icon,
  MoreHorizontalIcon,
  PencilEdit02Icon,
  Share08Icon,
} from "@hugeicons/core-free-icons";
import {
  ActionBar,
  ActionBarActions,
  ActionBarButton,
  ActionBarClose,
  ActionBarCount,
  ActionBarSelection,
  ActionBarSeparator,
  Badge,
  Button,
  Checkbox,
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuLabel,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
  Grid,
  GridItem,
  GridItemActions,
  GridItemDescription,
  GridItemFooter,
  GridItemHeader,
  GridItemMedia,
  GridItemSelect,
  GridItemTitle,
  GridSelectAll,
  GridToolbar,
  GridWrap,
  Icon,
  IconTile,
  toast,
} from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";

const assets = [
  {
    id: "asset-1",
    title: "Dashboard dark mode screenshot",
    subtitle: "PNG · 2880 × 1800 · 1.4 MB",
    tag: "Screenshot",
    variant: "info",
    spot: "var(--ayy-accent-product)",
    icon: Image01Icon,
  },
  {
    id: "asset-2",
    title: "Q4 launch announcement carousel",
    subtitle: "LinkedIn & X · 5 slides",
    tag: "Social post",
    variant: "success",
    spot: "var(--ayy-accent-marketing)",
    icon: Share08Icon,
  },
  {
    id: "asset-3",
    title: "Brand identity hero cover",
    subtitle: "WebP · 3840 × 2160 · 890 KB",
    tag: "Media asset",
    variant: "ai",
    spot: "var(--ayy-accent-brand)",
    icon: Image01Icon,
  },
] as const;

export default function Example() {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string[]>(["asset-1", "asset-2"]);
  const all = selected.length === assets.length;
  const toggle = (id: string, on: boolean) =>
    setSelected((list) => (on ? [...list, id] : list.filter((x) => x !== id)));

  return (
    <GridWrap>
      <GridToolbar>
        <GridSelectAll>
          <Checkbox
            aria-label="Select all media assets"
            checked={all}
            indeterminate={selected.length > 0 && !all}
            onCheckedChange={(on) => setSelected(on ? assets.map((a) => a.id) : [])}
          />
          <span>{selected.length ? `${selected.length} of ${assets.length} selected` : `${assets.length} items`}</span>
        </GridSelectAll>
      </GridToolbar>

      <Grid>
        {assets.map((asset) => {
          const isSelected = selected.includes(asset.id);
          return (
            <GridItem
              key={asset.id}
              selected={isSelected}
              onSelectedChange={(on) => toggle(asset.id, on)}
              style={{ "--ayy-spot": asset.spot } as React.CSSProperties}
            >
              <GridItemMedia className="ayy-bg-grid">
                <GridItemSelect>
                  <Checkbox
                    aria-label={`Select ${asset.title}`}
                    checked={isSelected}
                    onCheckedChange={(on) => toggle(asset.id, on)}
                  />
                </GridItemSelect>
                <IconTile size="lg">
                  <Icon icon={asset.icon} size="lg" />
                </IconTile>
                <GridItemActions>
                  <Button
                    variant="ghost"
                    size="icon-sm"
                    aria-label={`Copy ${asset.title}`}
                    onClick={() => toast.success(`Copied ${asset.title}`)}
                  >
                    <Icon icon={CopyLinkIcon} />
                  </Button>
                  <DropdownMenu>
                    <DropdownMenuTrigger
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="icon-sm"
                      aria-label={`More actions for ${asset.title}`}
                    >
                      <Icon icon={MoreHorizontalIcon} />
                    </DropdownMenuTrigger>
                    <DropdownMenuContent align="end">
                      <DropdownMenuLabel>{asset.title}</DropdownMenuLabel>
                      <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => toast(`Edit ${asset.title}`)}>
                        <Icon icon={PencilEdit02Icon} />
                        Edit details
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                      <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => toast.success(`Duplicated ${asset.title}`)} shortcut="Mod+D">
                        <Icon icon={Copy01Icon} />
                        Duplicate
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                      <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => toast.success(`Copied link to ${asset.title}`)} shortcut="Mod+C">
                        <Icon icon={CopyLinkIcon} />
                        Copy link
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                      <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => toast(`Archived ${asset.title}`)}>
                        <Icon icon={Archive02Icon} />
                        Archive
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                      <DropdownMenuSeparator />
                      <DropdownMenuItem destructive onSelect={() => toast.error(`Deleted ${asset.title}`)}>
                        <Icon icon={Delete02Icon} />
                        Delete
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                    </DropdownMenuContent>
                  </DropdownMenu>
                </GridItemActions>
              </GridItemMedia>

              <GridItemHeader>
                <div>
                  <GridItemTitle>{asset.title}</GridItemTitle>
                  <GridItemDescription>{asset.subtitle}</GridItemDescription>
                </div>
              </GridItemHeader>

              <GridItemFooter>
                <Badge variant={asset.variant}>{asset.tag}</Badge>
                <span>Updated today</span>
              </GridItemFooter>
            </GridItem>
          );
        })}
      </Grid>

      <ActionBar open={selected.length > 0} onClear={() => setSelected([])}>
        <ActionBarSelection>
          <ActionBarCount>{selected.length} selected</ActionBarCount>
          <ActionBarClose />
        </ActionBarSelection>
        <ActionBarSeparator />
        <ActionBarActions>
          <ActionBarButton onClick={() => toast(`Editing ${selected.length} items`)}>
            <Icon icon={PencilEdit02Icon} />
            Edit
          </ActionBarButton>
          <ActionBarButton onClick={() => toast.success(`Duplicated ${selected.length} items`)}>
            <Icon icon={Copy01Icon} />
            Duplicate
          </ActionBarButton>
          <ActionBarButton onClick={() => toast.success(`Copied ${selected.length} links`)}>
            <Icon icon={CopyLinkIcon} />
            Copy
          </ActionBarButton>
          <ActionBarButton onClick={() => toast(`Archived ${selected.length} items`)}>
            <Icon icon={Archive02Icon} />
            Archive
          </ActionBarButton>
          <ActionBarSeparator />
          <ActionBarButton
            destructive
            onClick={() => {
              toast.error(`Deleted ${selected.length} items`);
              setSelected([]);
            }}
          >
            <Icon icon={Delete02Icon} />
            Delete
          </ActionBarButton>
        </ActionBarActions>
      </ActionBar>
    </GridWrap>
  );
}
```

React:

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import {
  Archive02Icon,
  Copy01Icon,
  CopyLinkIcon,
  Delete02Icon,
  MoreHorizontalIcon,
  PencilEdit02Icon,
} from "@hugeicons/core-free-icons";
import {
  ActionBar,
  ActionBarActions,
  ActionBarButton,
  ActionBarClose,
  ActionBarCount,
  ActionBarSelection,
  ActionBarSeparator,
  Avatar,
  Badge,
  Button,
  Checkbox,
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuLabel,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
  Grid,
  GridItem,
  GridItemActions,
  GridItemBody,
  GridItemDescription,
  GridItemFooter,
  GridItemHeader,
  GridItemSelect,
  GridItemTitle,
  GridSelectAll,
  GridToolbar,
  GridWrap,
  Icon,
  toast,
} from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";

const records = [
  {
    id: "usr-1",
    name: "Maya Lin",
    role: "Staff Product Designer · Design Systems",
    summary: "Owns token architecture, accessibility reviews and Figma library sync.",
    status: "Active",
    variant: "success",
    team: "Core UI",
  },
  {
    id: "usr-2",
    name: "Ari Cohen",
    role: "Lead Frontend Engineer · Platform",
    summary: "Maintains custom elements runtime, SSR pipelines and bundle budgets.",
    status: "In review",
    variant: "warning",
    team: "Web Runtime",
  },
  {
    id: "usr-3",
    name: "Noa Levi",
    role: "Content Strategist · Social & Growth",
    summary: "Manages Q4 launch campaigns, social post templates and release notes.",
    status: "Active",
    variant: "info",
    team: "Marketing",
  },
] as const;

export default function Example() {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string[]>(["usr-1"]);
  const all = selected.length === records.length;
  const toggle = (id: string, on: boolean) =>
    setSelected((list) => (on ? [...list, id] : list.filter((x) => x !== id)));

  return (
    <GridWrap>
      <GridToolbar>
        <GridSelectAll>
          <Checkbox
            aria-label="Select all records"
            checked={all}
            indeterminate={selected.length > 0 && !all}
            onCheckedChange={(on) => setSelected(on ? records.map((r) => r.id) : [])}
          />
          <span>{selected.length ? `${selected.length} selected` : `${records.length} records`}</span>
        </GridSelectAll>
      </GridToolbar>

      <Grid>
        {records.map((person) => {
          const isSelected = selected.includes(person.id);
          return (
            <GridItem
              key={person.id}
              selected={isSelected}
              onSelectedChange={(on) => toggle(person.id, on)}
            >
              <GridItemHeader>
                <div className="ayy-cluster" style={{ "--ayy-gap": "var(--ayy-space-3)" } as React.CSSProperties}>
                  <GridItemSelect>
                    <Checkbox
                      aria-label={`Select ${person.name}`}
                      checked={isSelected}
                      onCheckedChange={(on) => toggle(person.id, on)}
                    />
                  </GridItemSelect>
                  <Avatar name={person.name} size="sm" />
                  <div>
                    <GridItemTitle>{person.name}</GridItemTitle>
                    <GridItemDescription>{person.role}</GridItemDescription>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <GridItemActions>
                  <Button
                    variant="ghost"
                    size="icon-sm"
                    aria-label={`Edit ${person.name}`}
                    onClick={() => toast(`Edit ${person.name}`)}
                  >
                    <Icon icon={PencilEdit02Icon} />
                  </Button>
                  <DropdownMenu>
                    <DropdownMenuTrigger
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="icon-sm"
                      aria-label={`More actions for ${person.name}`}
                    >
                      <Icon icon={MoreHorizontalIcon} />
                    </DropdownMenuTrigger>
                    <DropdownMenuContent align="end">
                      <DropdownMenuLabel>{person.name}</DropdownMenuLabel>
                      <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => toast(`Edit ${person.name}`)}>
                        <Icon icon={PencilEdit02Icon} />
                        Edit record
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                      <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => toast.success(`Duplicated ${person.name}`)} shortcut="Mod+D">
                        <Icon icon={Copy01Icon} />
                        Duplicate
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                      <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => toast.success(`Copied ${person.name}`)} shortcut="Mod+C">
                        <Icon icon={CopyLinkIcon} />
                        Copy profile link
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                      <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => toast(`Archived ${person.name}`)}>
                        <Icon icon={Archive02Icon} />
                        Archive
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                      <DropdownMenuSeparator />
                      <DropdownMenuItem destructive onSelect={() => toast.error(`Removed ${person.name}`)}>
                        <Icon icon={Delete02Icon} />
                        Delete
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                    </DropdownMenuContent>
                  </DropdownMenu>
                </GridItemActions>
              </GridItemHeader>

              <GridItemBody>
                <p>{person.summary}</p>
              </GridItemBody>

              <GridItemFooter>
                <Badge variant={person.variant}>{person.status}</Badge>
                <span>{person.team}</span>
              </GridItemFooter>
            </GridItem>
          );
        })}
      </Grid>

      <ActionBar open={selected.length > 0} onClear={() => setSelected([])}>
        <ActionBarSelection>
          <ActionBarCount>{selected.length} selected</ActionBarCount>
          <ActionBarClose />
        </ActionBarSelection>
        <ActionBarSeparator />
        <ActionBarActions>
          <ActionBarButton onClick={() => toast(`Editing ${selected.length} records`)}>
            <Icon icon={PencilEdit02Icon} />
            Edit
          </ActionBarButton>
          <ActionBarButton onClick={() => toast.success(`Duplicated ${selected.length} records`)}>
            <Icon icon={Copy01Icon} />
            Duplicate
          </ActionBarButton>
          <ActionBarButton onClick={() => toast.success(`Copied ${selected.length} records`)}>
            <Icon icon={CopyLinkIcon} />
            Copy
          </ActionBarButton>
          <ActionBarButton onClick={() => toast(`Archived ${selected.length} records`)}>
            <Icon icon={Archive02Icon} />
            Archive
          </ActionBarButton>
          <ActionBarSeparator />
          <ActionBarButton
            destructive
            onClick={() => {
              toast.error(`Deleted ${selected.length} records`);
              setSelected([]);
            }}
          >
            <Icon icon={Delete02Icon} />
            Delete
          </ActionBarButton>
        </ActionBarActions>
      </ActionBar>
    </GridWrap>
  );
}
```

## Chart

Category: Data display. Charts drawn by CSS with no library: columns (grouped or stacked), lines and areas, a ranked bar list and sparklines. Bars and ticks take --ayy-value (0–100), lines are SVG paths from chartPath(). Series colours are the chart tokens in order, so a chart library can match them. Also called: chart, bar-chart, line-chart, sparkline, graph.

**Classes**
- `.ayy-chart` — Root, usually a <figure>. A grid of the plot, the labels, the legend and the data table.
- `.ayy-chart--stacked` — A column's bars sit on top of each other; each bar's --ayy-value is its share of the top of the scale.
- `.ayy-chart--values` — Print every bar's data-value above it (otherwise only on hover).
- `.ayy-chart__plot` — The drawing area (aria-hidden="true"). Height from --ayy-chart-height (default 12rem). Holds ticks and either __bars or an __svg.
- `.ayy-chart__tick` — A value line across the plot, its text the label in the gutter. --ayy-value places it: 0 is the floor, 100 the top. The gutter only appears when there are ticks.
- `.ayy-chart__bars` — Row of columns filling the plot.
- `.ayy-chart__column` — One label's bars, side by side (or stacked).
- `.ayy-chart__bar` — A bar, fading toward its base (solid when stacked): --ayy-value is its height, data-value its text on hover. Its colour is chart-1, chart-2… by position in the column; --ayy-chart-color overrides.
- `.ayy-chart__svg` — <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" preserveAspectRatio="none"> stretched over the plot, for lines and areas. Mirrors in RTL.
- `.ayy-chart__series` — <g> around one series' area and line. Coloured chart-1, chart-2… in order; --ayy-chart-color overrides.
- `.ayy-chart__series--compare` — A comparison series (last period, a target): dashed, quiet, no fill.
- `.ayy-chart__line` — <path> of the line, 2px whatever the stretch (vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke).
- `.ayy-chart__area` — <path> of the area under the line: a 16% tint of the series colour, or fill="url(#…)" an __gradient in its series to fade out toward the floor (React does).
- `.ayy-chart__gradient` — A <linearGradient x2="0" y2="1"> with two <stop>s, inside the series' <g> (in <defs>): its stops take the series colour, 32% at the top to none at the floor.
- `.ayy-chart__labels` — The labels under the plot (aria-hidden="true"), one per column; under a line they spread from the first point to the last.
- `.ayy-chart__legend` — List of the series, when there's more than one (aria-hidden="true" when a data table names them).
- `.ayy-chart__legend-item` — A series name with its swatch, coloured in the same order as the series.
- `.ayy-chart__legend-item--compare` — Legend entry for a comparison series: a dashed swatch.
- `.ayy-chart__swatch` — The colour square in a legend item.
- `.ayy-bar-list` — <ol> of ranked rows (top pages, sources) with the bar behind the text. Readable as it is.
- `.ayy-bar-list__item` — A row; --ayy-value is the bar's length (100 = the largest). The bar fades along the row.
- `.ayy-bar-list__label` — The row's name (or a link), cut with an ellipsis.
- `.ayy-bar-list__value` — The row's number, tabular digits.
- `.ayy-sparkline` — A small <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" preserveAspectRatio="none"> line with no axes, for a stat or a table cell. Uses __line and __area paths.

**States**
- `default` — Bars, lines or areas in --ayy-chart-1… in order, muted s labels, hairline ticks; the drawing is aria-hidden and the numbers live in a table.
- `hover` (`.ayy-chart__column:hover`) — Its bars mix 20% toward the text colour and show their data-value above them.
- `pressed` — doesn't apply: Not interactive.
- `focus` — doesn't apply: Not focusable; the data table carries the numbers.
- `disabled` — doesn't apply: Not interactive.
- `selected` — doesn't apply: No selected bar or series.
- `error` — doesn't apply: No error look; show an Alert in its place.
- `loading` — doesn't apply: Use a block Skeleton of the chart's height while data loads; bars grow from 0 when they appear.

**Sizes**
- Density — The plot is --ayy-chart-height (12rem) tall; bar-list rows are at least the sm control height; a sparkline is 6rem × 1.75rem. Chart labels and legend text follow data-density via --ayy-text-s.
- Width — Fills its container; columns share the width (bars at most 2.5rem wide).

**React** — `import { BarChart, LineChart, Sparkline, BarList, TableChart } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";`
- `<BarChart>` renders <figure class="ayy-chart"> with a plot of __column/__bar, labels, a legend and a visually hidden data table. Props: `label` string — what it shows ("Signups per day"); the data table's caption; `labels` string[] — one per column; `series` { name, values: number[], color? }[]; `stacked` boolean; `showValues` boolean — print values above the bars; `max` number — top of the scale; rounded up from the data if omitted; `ticks` number of value lines, default 3; 0 for none; `format` (value: number) => string — ticks, hover values and the table; default compact (1.2K); `height` CSS length, default 12rem; `legend` boolean — default: more than one series
- `<LineChart>` renders <figure class="ayy-chart"> with an __svg of __series paths, labels, a legend and a visually hidden data table. Props: `label` string — the data table's caption; `labels` string[] — one per point; `series` { name, values: number[], color?, compare? }[] — compare draws a dashed comparison line; `min` number, default 0; `max` number; `area` boolean, default true; `smooth` boolean, default true (monotone: never overshoots a point); `ticks` number, default 3; `format` (value: number) => string; `height` CSS length; `legend` boolean
- `<Sparkline>` renders <svg class="ayy-sparkline">. Props: `values` number[]; `label` string — makes it role="img" with this name; without it the sparkline is aria-hidden; `area` boolean; `color` CSS colour, default chart-1; `min` number, default the smallest value; `max` number, default the largest value
- `<BarList>` renders <ol class="ayy-bar-list">. Props: `items` { label: ReactNode, value: number, href? }[]; `max` number — value of a full bar, default the largest; `format` (value: number) => string, default grouped digits; `color` CSS colour, default chart-1
- `<TableChart>` renders <div class="ayy-table-wrap"><table class="ayy-table"> with headers, swatches and numeric cells. Props: `label` string — what it shows; the table's caption; `labels` string[] — one per row along the side; `series` { name, values: number[], color?, compare? }[]; `format` (value: number) => string — cell values; default compact (1.2K); `compact` boolean — tighter row padding

**Accessibility**
- The drawing is aria-hidden. The numbers go in a table (React renders one with .ayy-sr-only; add a visible Table if people need to compare values), with a <caption> saying what the chart shows.
- Don't rely on colour alone: a legend names the series in the same order, the comparison series is dashed, and a title or a Stat states the takeaway ("Up 12% on last week").
- Series tokens keep 3:1 against every surface in every theme. In High Contrast bars and lines take system colours, alternating between CanvasText and Highlight.
- A Sparkline with a label is an image with that name; give it the trend in words ("Revenue, last 14 days, up 12%").

**Do**
- Use a chart to show a trend or a comparison at a glance: signups per day, revenue against last month, traffic by source. Put it in a Card with the title and the key number (a Stat) above it.
- Use a bar chart to compare amounts across a few categories or periods, a line chart for a trend over many points, a bar list for a ranking, a sparkline beside a number.
- Colour series with the chart tokens in order (React does it). With a chart library, pass var(--ayy-chart-1)… (SVG) or chartColors() (canvas), and chartTheme() for its text, grid and tooltip.
- Mark the previous period as a compare series instead of a second bright colour.
- Keep the scale honest: bars start at 0; let chartScale() round the top.

**Don't**
- Don't use a chart when the exact numbers matter more than the shape — use a Table.
- Don't use a pie or donut for parts of a whole — a Bar list or a stacked bar is easier to read.
- Don't pick series colours from the status or accent tokens unless the colour means something (success for a goal line).
- Don't draw more than six series; group the rest as Other.
- Don't add a second chart library just for a simple bar or line — these cover dashboards. Reach for one (Recharts, Chart.js) for zoom, brushing or maps, themed with the tokens.

React:

```tsx
import type { CSSProperties } from "react";
import { Card, CardContent, Sparkline, Stat } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";

const stats = [
  { label: "Visitors", value: "12.8k", trend: "up 9%", values: [8, 9, 8.5, 10, 9.8, 11, 10.6, 11.8, 12.1, 12.8], color: undefined },
  { label: "Conversion", value: "3.4%", trend: "up 0.3 points", values: [3.1, 3.2, 3.1, 3.2, 3.3, 3.2, 3.3, 3.4, 3.3, 3.4], color: undefined },
  { label: "Churn", value: "1.9%", trend: "down 0.4 points", values: [2.4, 2.3, 2.3, 2.2, 2.1, 2.2, 2, 2, 1.9, 1.9], color: "var(--ayy-color-success)" },
];

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="ayy-grid" style={{ "--ayy-min": "12rem", inlineSize: "100%" } as CSSProperties}>
      {stats.map((stat) => (
        <Card key={stat.label}>
          <CardContent>
            <div className="ayy-spread" style={{ alignItems: "end" } as CSSProperties}>
              <Stat labelFirst size="sm" label={stat.label} value={stat.value} />
              <Sparkline
                values={stat.values}
                area
                label={`${stat.label}, last 10 days, ${stat.trend}`}
                color={stat.color}
              />
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```
